name: Historian Dr Hilda

intro.text: The Synod of Whitby in 664 decided how the English church would count Easter. Years of argument, a lot of calendars, and the answer was Rome's. History hinges on small things.

win: I yield. A sound argument, and an excellent hat.
after: Hilda was an abbess, and a teacher of bishops. Five of her pupils became bishops. That is a better record than most schools.
